_comment: THIMBLEWICK - a tiny cottage garden, seen at beetle size. A walk-and-wonder world: clover leaves for umbrellas, a teacup for a pond, tall flowers standing like trees, and a long whitewashed picket fence (one tree-kind picket every 12 px along y=-700) with a lane behind it that only something small can reach. Eight regions: Far Side (behind the fence), Clover Commons, Dew Run, Hose Works, Teacup Green, Button Meadow, the Doorstep (where you arrive) and Peg Corner. It RE-SKINS ITSELF through its 'art' block (deep-merged over data/art.json): its own garden terrain + litter atlas, flower stalks as tree kinds (daisy, poppy, cosmos, dandelion, foxglove, bluebell, clover, grass, picket), tea for water, a golden afternoon. The fence gaps are missing pickets; see the 'secret' block (reveal type 'fetch'). Generated by tools/gen_thimblewick_world.py (art: pokepals/tools/gen_thimblewick.py) - edit that and re-run, don't hand-tune positions.
intro: A garden, and you are the size of a beetle. Clover is an umbrella, a teacup is a pond, and the fence is a castle wall. Nothing needs doing. Look up.

props.label: a gap in the fence
props.lore: A gap in the fence where a picket has rotted clean away: ten fingers wide, if you had fingers that size. You couldn't get a shoulder through it. Something smaller and quicker might.

props.label: a gap in the fence
props.lore: A gap between two leaning pickets, worn smooth at the bottom by small feet. You'd stick fast. A rabbit would not.

props.label: a gap in the fence
props.lore: Here a picket has fallen and a bit of the dust has been scooped into a dip. It leads somewhere you cannot follow. Tap your companion and choose Go look, and in the right shape it might.

props.label: a gap in the fence
props.lore: A thread of red cotton snagged on the picket runs through this gap, as if someone small once dragged something heavy through it. You cannot follow. Your companion, if it were small and quick, could.

props.label: a gap in the fence
props.lore: A gap by the corner post, half-hidden in grass. On the far side you can see a little worn path, no wider than a rabbit.

props.label: a trail of red cotton
props.lore: Red cotton, snagged on a picket and trailing out across the dust. It is not quite the colour of anything else in the garden.

props.label: a cotton reel
props.lore: A cotton reel, standing on end like a tower, wound with red. It has been unwinding for a long time, and the loose end leads off to the fence.

props.label: a clothes-peg
props.lore: A wooden clothes-peg, dropped from a line you can't see for the height of the stalks. It would make a fine bench, if you could climb it.

props.label: a button as big as a trampoline
props.lore: A button the size of a trampoline, four holes and a loop of red cotton still through two of them. Somebody's coat has been one button short since spring.

props.label: a watering can
props.lore: A copper watering can, green at the seams. Its spout is a tunnel and its rose a cloud of tiny sunken stars. It still smells of rain.

props.label: a coiled garden hose
props.lore: A garden hose, coiled like a sleeping serpent. It is warm from the sun, and full of a faint, patient sound that is only water waiting.

props.label: a tipped flowerpot
props.lore: A terracotta pot, lying on its side with its mouth full of shade: a cave, with a floor of spilled earth. Something has been living in it and has just gone out.

props.label: an empty snail shell
props.lore: An empty snail shell, banded in tawny stripes and large as a boulder. Its owner has long since moved on to a bigger house.

props.label: a seed packet
props.lore: A seed packet leaning on a stone, its painted flower faded to a rumour. The picture shows something far larger than you've ever seen grow here. Perhaps it is the sunflowers.

props.label: a bottle top
props.lore: A bottle top, upside down and full of rain: a round pool a hundred beetles could bathe in. A leaf is going round on it, very slowly.

props.label: a bead of dew
props.lore: A bead of dew, big as a beehive, with the whole garden upside down in it. You are in there too, very small.

props.label: a bead of dew
props.lore: Dew, held in a hollow of a leaf. It wobbles when you step near and the sky wobbles with it.

props.label: a bead of dew
props.lore: A cold, clear bead. Everything in it is the wrong way up and quite beautiful.

props.label: a drop on the saucer rim
props.lore: Cold tea, a lake of it, in a cup larger than a barn, and a saucer you could hold a feast on. It smells of bergamot and of someone who sat here once and forgot to finish.

_secret_comment: This world's one SECRET (docs/home-world-and-secrets-design.md, 'Thimblewick'). reveal.type 'fetch': in a shape from reveal.species (a rabbit) the companion, sent with Go look, squeezes through the nearest of reveal.gaps (mouth: outside the fence; inside: behind it; cache: where the finds lie), is gone a few seconds and brings back the best entry of that gap's 'finds' whose min_bond the bond has reached (FetchTrip / FetchDirector). The thimble is dropped at the PLAYER's feet wherever they stand, so the server honours a claim anywhere in this world (radius covers it); 'position' is only where it comes from.

secret.lore: A thimble: a little silver cup, dimpled all over, with a rim worn smooth by a lifetime of pushing needles. For you it is a bell tower. Someone has been missing it for a very long time.

pebble.label: a pebble
pebble.lore: A pebble, round and grey and warm from the sun on the other side of the fence. For you it is a boulder. Your companion is enormously proud of it.
pebble.drop: It sets a pebble at your feet and looks up at you, shining. A good pebble. It would bring something finer, perhaps, if it knew you better.

acorn.label: an acorn cup
acorn.lore: An acorn's little hat, big as a bathtub, with the pattern of the nut still printed in it. Someone's lunch, a season ago.
acorn.drop: It trots out dragging an acorn cup, and lays it down with great ceremony.

feather.label: a feather
feather.lore: A feather as long as a canoe, soft and grey with a pale stripe, from a bird you have never once seen in this garden. It is much too light for something so big.
feather.drop: It comes back with a long grey feather held high, like a banner.

bead.label: a glass bead
bead.lore: A glass bead, blue as a swimming pool, with a bubble caught in its middle and the whole sky in its curve. It must have rolled off a necklace years ago.
bead.drop: It rolls a blue glass bead out through the gap and nudges it to you, pleased.

button.label: a button
button.lore: A pearly button, four holes and a few threads of red still in them. It belongs to the same coat as the one in the meadow, you'd bet. Something deeper in there might be worth more.
button.drop: It comes back carrying a button, red thread trailing from its holes. Closer. There is something else back there, and it knows it.

thimble.label: a silver thimble
thimble.lore: A thimble: a little silver cup, dimpled all over, with a rim worn smooth by a lifetime of pushing needles. For you it is a bell tower. Someone has been missing it for a very long time.
thimble.drop: It is carrying something that gleams, held so carefully that it does not blink. Your companion sets down a silver thimble at your feet.

lines.notice: Your companion stops and stares at the fence. There is a gap there, a very small one.
lines.set_off: Off it trots to the fence, to see what is on the other side.
lines.too_big: It nudges at the gap and cannot fit. A gap this size wants something small and quick: a rabbit's shape, perhaps.
lines.gave_up_big: It gives up with a sigh and a flop. Tap it and pick a smaller shape, then ask again.
lines.lost_way: It couldn't find a way to the gap from here. Try again from nearer the fence.
lines.called_off: You whistle, and it turns back from the fence.
lines.gone: It squeezes through and is gone. The long grass behind the fence rustles.
lines.missing: The garden is very big, and very quiet, without it.
lines.hurry: It hears you, and scrabbles back out in a hurry.
lines.carrying: There it is, slipping out of the gap with something almost as big as it is.
lines.set_down: It sets its find down where it stands, and sits beside it, waiting.
lines.no_gap: There's no gap in the fence near enough. Walk along the fence and look for one.
lines.busy: Your companion is off on an errand. Wait for it, or whistle it back.
lines.more: There is something more back there, it seems to say. It might fetch it once you know each other better.

reveal.reveal_line: It trots out of the fence with something shining held high, and sets it down in front of you with a small, triumphant sneeze.

secret.found_line: A thimble, as big as a bell, silver and dented. Somebody sewed through a long winter with it and lost it on the wrong side of the fence. It has come home, carried by the only one who could fit through.

keepsake.label: a silver thimble on a spool of red cotton
keepsake.line: A thimble on a spool of red cotton. Your companion sits and looks at it sometimes, as if remembering a very tight squeeze.

portals.label: the way back to the Vale
